description: An eight channel splitter and merger: a polyphonic cable is split out to eight mono jacks, eight mono jacks are merged into a polyphonic cable, and a knob per channel crossfades between the two

params.text: Crossfades one channel of the POLY output between the IN jack of that number and the channel of the POLY input of that number, the IN jack alone fully anticlockwise

inputs.text: A signal merged into the POLY output on the channel matching its number, and the knob for that channel crossfades it against the POLY input
The polyphonic cable that is split out, its channel 1 going to OUT 1, its channel 2 to OUT 2 and so on

outputs.text: Carries the channel of the POLY input matching its number as a mono signal, with no knob acting on it
The eight IN jacks merged into one polyphonic cable, each channel crossfaded against the POLY input by its own knob; the highest numbered IN jack in use sets the channel count

notes: SMExpL immediately to the left adds IN 9 to IN 16, and SMExpR immediately to the right adds OUT 9 to OUT 16
